scope: One bounded summary of existing B1/B2 evidence; no new long training or new method was run.

B1_behavior_support.finding: Bounded BC-centered exploration expanded action support, but primary global top1/top3/Spearman/sign metrics regressed or were not globally stable; epsilon=0.10 had slightly lower regret only.

B2_R0_full.finding: Counterfactual branches expose action disagreement, but remain close to the BC manifold and show phase-dependent ranking plus collision/return-target contamination.

B3_model_gate.finding: No candidate learned critic checkpoint was clearly better on the ranking-first common benchmark; B2 raw Q is diagnostic-only, not a pretrained critic.

root_cause_assessment.primary: state coverage insufficiency together with phase-dependent action ranking
root_cause_assessment.secondary: counterfactual target noise from collision/unsuccessful branches and direct-return heterogeneity
root_cause_assessment.not_proven: critic fitting/architecture alone as the dominant cause; no controlled candidate isolated it
root_cause_assessment.interpretation: B1 answers natural action-support expansion is insufficient; B2 answers R0 reveals ranking disagreement but does not yet supply clean learned supervision.

next_step_candidates: Hold B4 blocked until a new user/MASTER-approved critic method is registered.
If revisited, separate successful/failed/collision target strata and report phase-specific ranking before training a new critic.
If revisited, use bounded off-BC state aggregation only with an explicit target-quality gate; do not auto-run R1/R2.
